title: Adds destination property and new enum values to Reserve Plans, Holds and Releases
summary: Adds a destination property to all three Reserve objects. You can now identify which balance holds reserved funds and where those funds go when they’re released: Previously, every Reserve Plan and Reserve Hold used the risk_reserved balance, and every Reserve Release sent funds to the payments balance. Those assumptions are no longer valid.
migrationNotes: You can now represent risk and settlement reserves accurately, track where released funds are sent, and recognize plans that release funds only when disabled.
Check the destination property on Reserve Plan, Reserve Hold, and Reserve Release objects rather than assuming a destination.
Support manual_release plans and use manual_release to identify their release behavior.
Handle the new Reserve Plan type and status values.
